artworks.title: Buffalo Dance - Mandan
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures engaged in a circle dance. The figures are adorned with intricate attire and positioned in a circular formation. They each hold long spears. The background contains swirling hues of blue, orange, and yellow. This is in the style of George Catlin.

artworks.title: Game of the Arrow - Mandan
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: A Foot War Party in Council - Mandan
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene of a group of Native American men sitting in a circle. They are gathered around a central point, likely a small fire. The background shows rolling hills and trees under a sky with clouds. The brushstrokes are smooth and the color palette includes earthy tones with touches of blue. Various objects such as shields and spears are placed around the group.

artworks.title: A Mandan Medicine Man
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of Native Americans participating in a ceremonial gathering. The painting depicts a group of people gathered outdoors on a grassy field, encircled by hills under a sky with scattered clouds. At the forefront stands a figure adorned in traditional attire, including a feathered headdress and garments with detailed patterning. The figure appears to be holding ceremonial objects and addressing or leading the assembly. Around this central figure, the people are positioned in various postures, seemingly listening or observing attentively. The scene is framed within an oval border, highlighting the central action while subtly incorporating a background structure that resembles an earthen or wooden lodge. The atmosphere is serene, with muted colors suggesting a peaceful observance. This is in the style of George Catlin, known for his portraits of Native American life.

artworks.title: Three Iowa Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in a side by side full-body view. The person on the left holds a curved object in their right hand. They have short, black hair with a red feather and wear fringed pants and a garment covering their upper body. The person in the middle holds a long spear in their left hand and wears a headband with red and white feathers. They have long black hair and wear a fur wrap over one shoulder. The person on the right holds a long staff in their left hand and also wears a feathered headband. They have black hair tied with feathers and wear fringed leggings. The background of the image shows abstract blue and pink hues, with a suggestion of grass. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame against a plain beige background.

artworks.title: Three Iroquois Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Three Riccarree Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side. The person on the left wears a robe and has long dark hair with feathers. The middle person, also with dark hair and feathers, is holding a staff and a shield. The person on the right has long dark hair, wearing a fur-lined robe over a decorated dress. They all wear traditional clothing with vibrant patterns and colors. The background suggests an open natural setting with grass and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: An Aged Ojibbeway Chief and Three Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Four individuals are sitting on the ground in a semi-circle. The first individual on the left is wrapped in a light-colored cloth and holding a staff. The second person has long hair with a feather, and is wearing decorative clothing. The third person has a feathered headdress and long hair, and the fourth person has a headdress with white and red elements. They are all wearing clothing with fringes and decorative details. The background shows a natural outdoor setting with green trees in the distance.

artworks.title: Two Ojibbeway Warriors and a Woman
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in full-length depiction against a softly colored background. On the left, a man stands with a relaxed posture, his left hand holding a long pipe and his right hand holding a small fur. His facial expression is calm, and he has long brown hair adorned with feathers. He is dressed in a skin garment, and his limbs are marked with patterns. In the center, another man stands in a similar relaxed position, holding a long spear vertically. He wears a feathered headdress, dark hair cascades down his shoulders, and sports patterned skin garments, fur, and a sash draped over his shoulder. To the right, a woman stands holding a wrapped infant in a cradleboard. She has short dark hair and gentle facial features. She wears a dress and shawl combination with a delicate design and multiple necklaces. The background is a simple gradient between earthy tones and a subtle sky.

artworks.title: Ojibbeway Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals. On the left, two adults are standing, with one sitting in the center. They have long dark hair adorned with feathers and wear intricate clothing. To the right, three young males are in motion, with one aiming a bow and arrow, and the other two holding bows and arrows. A large tipi with decorative designs is in the background, with grassy ground below. The sky is a blend of soft blue tones.

artworks.title: Saukie Warrior, His Wife, and a Boy
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in the image. In the center, a person holds a shield and spear, with facial paint, long dark hair, a feather, and a headpiece adorned with feathers. To the left, another person holds a stick, wears a long garment, and has short hair with a feathered headpiece. On the right, a third person stands with hands clasped in front, wearing a patterned dress, and long dark hair. The background shows a grassy surface under a blue sky, framed in an oval with a border.

artworks.title: Black Hawk and Five Other Saukie Prisoners
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Two Saukie Chiefs and a Woman
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image features three full-body figures in an oval frame. On the left, a person stands with folded arms, wearing patterned attire. In the center, an individual holds a staff and axe, wearing a feathered headdress. On the right, another person holds a decorated shield, wearing a headdress and fringed clothing. The background shows a softly colored sky and greenish hue, with the number "15" at the top.

artworks.title: The Running Fox on a Fine Horse - Saukie
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting atop a dark horse in an open field. The person is upright on the horse, which is in mid-stride on a grassy plain. The person has a prominent facial structure with high cheekbones and long dark hair adorned with a feather. The person is wearing a fringed garment made of animal hide decorated with patterns, along with leggings and moccasins. The person holds a long stick or staff, and the horse's tack is adorned with colorful designs. The background features a vast sky with subtle blue and pink hues, suggesting either dawn or dusk. There are no other objects or structures in the background, conveying an expansive natural setting. The image is framed by an oval shape and a rectangular matte.

artworks.title: Menomonie Chief, His Wife, and Son
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in full-length portraits. The individual on the left wears a patterned garment with fringes and feathers on their headdress. They have long, black hair and distinct facial features. The central person wears a tunic, loincloth, and a feathered headdress. The person on the right is wrapped in a pink embroidered shawl and has long, straight black hair. The background shows a softly painted landscape with grass and a pastel sky. The scene is bordered by an oval frame within a rectangular canvas.

artworks.title: Old Menomonie Chief with Two Young Beaux
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals against a natural background. On the left, a man is seated on the ground, his body wrapped in a beige cloth. He has long, dark hair and a solemn expression, holding a long pipe. On the right, two standing men are shown from head to toe. Both have dark hair; one with two long braids and the other with a feathered headdress. The man with the headdress holds a shield adorned with feathers. The men wear red leggings, beadwork, fringed garments, necklaces, and jewelry. One has a draped pinkish-white cloth over his shoulder. The background features a grassland with a distant sky overhead.

artworks.title: Two Ottoe Chiefs and a Woman
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing outdoors. The person on the left wears a headdress with feathers and a fur-like garment with beadwork. They hold a long object with tassels and feathers. To the right, another person wears a white garment with black and red designs and a feathered headdress. The third person carries a child on their back in a light pink shawl with decorative elements, holding a similar decorated long object. The background has soft, sky-like tones in blue and green.

artworks.title: Weeco Chief, His Wife, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals standing outdoors. On the left, a woman stands with her child. The woman is wrapped in a patterned blanket and has long, black hair. The child is dressed simply. In the center, another individual stands with long, dark hair adorned with feathers and a painted face. This person wears a necklace and an ornate wrap. The fourth person stands on the right, holding a decorated spear. This individual has long hair tied back, showing a bare upper body, and is draped in a blanket around the waist. All are set against a painted sky and grassy terrain, enclosed in an oval frame with a brown and green border.

artworks.title: Three Piankeshaw Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body depictions of individuals standing next to each other. The central person is wearing a pink shawl with fringe detailing, beige leggings, and moccasins, and holding a ceremonial staff. The person on the left is wearing a beige dress with decorative detailing and layered necklaces, and holding a basket. The person on the right is standing with arms folded under a white blanket with red trim and has a feather in their hair. In the background, the image has a soft gradient that transitions from a light sky to the grassy ground, creating a simple and serene backdrop. There is an oval frame around the depiction.

artworks.title: Kaskaskia Chief, His Mother, and Son
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image is a painting depicting three people standing on grass with a sky in the background. On the far left is an adult woman with long dark hair, wearing a tan dress and necklaces. In the center is an adult man in a dark coat, white shirt, and boots, holding the hand of a young boy dressed in minimal clothing with feathers in his hair and holding a bow and arrow. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame with a brown border, and the background suggests a peaceful outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Seneca Chief, Red Jacket, with Two Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side, facing forward. The person on the left has long dark hair with feathers and beads, wearing an orange cloak. The middle figure wears a feathered headdress, a white fringed garment with red accents. The person on the right also has long hair with feather adornments, wearing a light-colored garment with patterns and a sash. They hold a curved pipe and two arrows. The background displays lush greenery, a possible waterfall or river, under a cloudy blue sky. The scene is framed in an oval border against a grey-beige outer mat.

artworks.title: Puncah Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing and sitting. The central figure stands with feathers in their long hair and wears a decorated cloak. The two seated individuals have long dark hair and wear cloaks with intricate patterns. The central figure holds a small object. The background is a simple scene with grass and a light blue sky, bordered by a green frame.
